blocks.html:
• Every synced table starts with the same five columns:
ColumnTypeSet byWhy
iduuid primary keyAppRows are created offline, so the app makes the id
uidtextServer, from the tokenOwner; every query filters it
revbigintServerPosition in the user's change history; pull reads rev > since
client_updated_attimestamptzAppLast write wins
deleted_attimestamptzApp (delete)Tombstone, purged after 90 days
  • Index (uid, rev) on every synced table makes pull fast.
  • Business columns: 01-api §6.3; exact SQL: the migration files.
